input.quote: 3.19 Exclusivity Commitment of SFJ. During the applicable Exclusive Period, SFJ shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, either by itself or through a Third Party, conduct human clinical trials of, or sell, offer for sale or have sold:
input.rationale: The only exclusivity/non-compete covenant in the Agreement (Section 3.19, with the "Exclusive Period" and "Competing Product"/"Brilinta Competing Product" definitions at 1.1.68, 1.1.43 and 1.1.18) binds SFJ and its Affiliates, not PB; it restrains the counterparty and therefore benefits us. No provision restricts the businesses PB may operate or the products it may develop, acquire or sell, and Section 15.15 confirms all rights not expressly granted to SFJ are reserved to PB and its Affiliates. The remaining PB-side negative covenants in Article 7.5 (7.5.5 Licensing Transactions, 7.5.6 royalty-stream sales, 7.5.7 further negative pledges) are financing/collateral-protection covenants tied to the funded Product, not non-compete or field-of-use restraints: 7.5.5 leaves PB free to enter any Excluded Licensing Transaction (expressly including licensing its ELP technology products such as PB1046 and PB1023) without SFJ consent, and consent elsewhere may only be withheld on a reasoned "Material Impact" determination subject to expedited arbitration. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
